A clear note
on your information.

How information submitted through this website is used.

Enquiries

When you send an enquiry, we use the details you provide to review your request, respond and discuss a potential working relationship. Required fields are marked. Please do not include sensitive personal information in a project brief.

Email delivery

When configured, this website uses Resend to deliver enquiry and newsletter requests. If enquiry delivery is unavailable, you can choose to open your own email app with a prepared draft. Opening the draft does not send it.

Field notes

Newsletter sign-up requires your agreement. We use your email for the requested field notes. You can ask to stop receiving them by contacting support@theimamcollective.com, or use the unsubscribe option in a delivered newsletter where provided.

Local demos and preferences

The dashboard and automation examples use sample data and do not connect to customer accounts. The website does not include third-party advertising trackers or load an analytics service by default. Hosting providers may process technical request logs to operate and secure the site.

Questions or requests

For questions about information you have submitted, correction or deletion requests, contact support@theimamcollective.com. This notice should be reviewed against your final hosting, business and data-retention arrangements before publication.
